summary: Frontend-only Playwright smoke of Vocotap (390x844) validating the 7-change batch (web-testable parts). ALL 5 in-scope flows PASS: (1) Editor live-drag preview works — with Record ON + Play running, short tap adds a tap note, ~500ms press-hold grows a vertical tail preview and commits a hold, horizontal drag renders wavy trail dots following the cursor and commits a wavy note (verified visually in artifacts_iter3/02_hold_preview.jpeg and 03_wavy_preview.jpeg). Note counter incremented 0→1→2→3→4 as each release committed. (2) Test button position confirmed via bounding boxes: record-btn at x=12,y=123 and test-btn at x=110,y=123 (same row, test to the RIGHT of record inside the mode bar). play-btn is far below at y=712 (transport row). (3) Save with two overlapping holds in the same lane succeeded — save-chart-button flipped to 'Saved' with no errors thrown; clampHolds() ran cleanly. (4) Library import: tapping import-audio-button on web preview does NOT crash; picker cancels silently and no red banner appears (expected). The import-error-banner element+testID is wired correctly in library.tsx and will render only when importSong throws (verified in source). (5) Navigation Home→Editor→back→Library→back all work; app boots past the animated LoadingScreen; VocoTap logo image renders on home. Multitouch feel and real-device audio duration probe are device-only and correctly excluded.

issues: Cosmetic only: note counter text always shows plural 'NOTES' even when count is 1 ('1 NOTES · CUSTOM CHART'). Not a spec item.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still emits 'shadow*' → boxShadow, 'textShadow*' → textShadow, and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents deprecation warnings. Non-blocking, previously reported in iteration_2.

Fetches to https://treesh.app/content/songs and the allorigins proxy fail with CORS on the web preview. Does not affect the tested flows (falls back to built-in songs). Reference: /app/frontend/src/game/AppState.tsx (treesh fetch).

action_items: (Optional polish) Pluralize the editor note counter: `${notes.length} NOTE${notes.length === 1 ? '' : 'S'} · CUSTOM CHART` in /app/frontend/app/editor.tsx:159.
(Optional, pre-existing) Address RN-Web style-prop deprecations (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents) — not caused by this batch.
critical_code_review_comments: editor.tsx PanResponder correctly uses capture-phase (onStartShouldSetPanResponderCapture) gated on recordingRef.current so touches during Record steal from note-select — verified in-app.
editor.tsx `preview` useMemo depends on drawTick which is bumped by both onPanResponderMove and a 60ms interval, giving smooth hold-tail growth and wave trail without needing native driver — good.
editor.tsx save() calls buildChart() which wraps notes through clampHolds() before saveChart — overlapping holds in same lane no longer error on save.
library.tsx doImport() try/catches importSong and surfaces error via `import-error-banner` (Pressable + close icon). Dismissing on tap works.

AppState.tsx importSong() broadens picker MIME (audio/*, public.audio, application/ogg, application/octet-stream) and probes real duration via createAudioPlayer with a 25×120ms poll; wrapped in try/catch that rethrows a user-friendly Error — matches spec item (6) and (7).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Viewport 390x844. Flow: open-editor-button → editor-record-button (toggles to 'Recording') → editor-play-button → mouse-down/hold/drag on the black board area (approx y=380 works) → mouse-up. editor-note-count testID reports 'N NOTES · CUSTOM CHART'. Editor Test button lives in the mode bar (same row as Record); play/restart/time live in the transport row below the seek slider. Library import-error-banner is dismissable by tap.
